description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for CBOE index snapshots, including query parameters, data transformation, and data fetching logic.

classes.name: CboeIndexSnapshotsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for CBOE index snapshots, including region validation.

classes.name: CboeIndexSnapshotsData
classes.description: Represents the data structure for CBOE index snapshots, including price and volume info.

classes.name: CboeIndexSnapshotsFetcher
classes.description: Handles data fetching and transformation from CBOE endpoints for index snapshots.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a CboeIndexSnapshotsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw data from CBOE API based on query parameters.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into standardized CboeIndexSnapshotsData objects.
